title: Largest Sum of Averages
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, partition the array into at most k non-empty adjacent subarrays to maximize the sum of their averages.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, partition the array into at most k non-empty adjacent subarrays to maximize the sum of their averages. The score must cover all integers in nums, and can be a non-integer. Acceptable answers are within 10^-6 of the true value.
constraints: Split into at most k nonempty adjacent groups and maximize the sum of group averages.
hints: The final score is additive once the next partition boundary is chosen.
Use suffix DP for each allowed group count with prefix sums for O(1) averages.
Trying every first boundary covers every adjacent partition; positive values ensure using all k groups is never worse.
editorial: Trying every first boundary covers every adjacent partition; positive values ensure using all k groups is never worse.
